about: Real shots used to develop and regression-test the tracker. Videos are not in this public repo: links and download steps are in the owner's private Google Doc 'Shot Clock – test clips (private)'. All clips are in one shared album, in this order. Save each video locally as <id>.mp4 and run: node tools/eval.mjs --dir <folder>

clips.setup: hand-held, warm indoor light, two spouts into a black cup and a pink mug
clips.notes: under-tamped per the owner; went light very early
clips.firstLiquidCheck: frames: nothing at 10.1 s, both dark streams at 10.27 s

clips.setup: hand-held, looking down, both spouts into one red-lined mug, stainless backsplash
clips.firstLiquidCheck: first drop ~9.9 s, dark stream running at 10.13 s
clips.notes: a thin stream is still running at 40 s

clips.setup: hand-held, daylight with sun dappling over a white cup; re-framed in the first 2 s and moved a lot (up to 11% zoom, 18% shift)
clips.firstLiquidCheck: frames: nothing at 8.5 s, drops at 8.9 s

clips.setup: further back and steadier, patterned mug, stainless all around
clips.firstLiquidCheck: frames: nothing at 9.3 s, both streams at 9.57 s

clips.setup: hand-held, warm light, both spouts into a plain white mug
clips.firstLiquidCheck: frames: nothing at 8.9 s, drops at 9.03 s

clips.setup: hand-held, daylight with sun stripes across a white mug
clips.firstLiquidCheck: frames: nothing at 9.2 s, streams at 9.37 s

clips.setup: hand-held, recording starts mid-shot with coffee already flowing; camera re-framed in the first ~8 s
clips.firstLiquidCheck: coffee flowing in the first frame; the correct result is no shot start

clips.setup: hand-held, wide faceted cup (crema visible), stainless; camera moves at the first drops and zooms out at ~8 s
clips.firstLiquidCheck: frames: nothing at 1.4 s, first drop at 1.8 s; recording starts only ~2 s before the first drop
clips.notes: hard case: the scene can only be learned for ~1 s before the first drops, while the camera moves
